description: Build the full spec-to-test pipeline: scaffold → adapter layer → pymupdf4llm extraction + section chunking → LLM extraction with mobilityhouse schema RAG → Jinja2 code gen + semantic QA → CLI → unit tests. Datatypes imported from mobilityhouse/ocpp (not extracted from PDF).

context_sources.query: spec-to-test pipeline pymupdf4llm mobilityhouse RAG accuracy
context_sources.reason: Architecture decisions from research: pymupdf4llm, mobilityhouse/ocpp, section-chunking, two-step LLM, semantic QA

steps.task: Scaffold the spec-to-test Python project. Create pyproject.toml with deps: pymupdf4llm>=0.0.17, pdfplumber>=0.11 (fallback), ocpp>=2.0.0 (mobilityhouse), pydantic>=2, jinja2>=3, anthropic>=0.40, sentence-transformers>=3, pytest>=8, pytest-asyncio>=0.24, click>=8. Create full src/ tree: extractors/, llm/, models/, ir/, generators/templates/, adapters/. Create tests/fixtures/. Add .gitignore. The src/llm/ directory will hold the LLM extraction layer (two-step prompt + retry).

context_needed.reason: Architecture overview and planned directory structure

output.summary: Scaffolded project: pyproject.toml with all deps (pymupdf4llm, ocpp, pydantic, anthropic, jinja2, sentence-transformers, click, pytest-asyncio), full src/ tree (extractors/, llm/, models/, ir/, generators/templates/, adapters/), tests/fixtures/, .gitignore

decisions: pyproject.toml uses hatchling build backend, asyncio_mode=auto for pytest-asyncio, src/ layout with spec_to_test package name

steps.task: Implement the adapter layer: (1) src/adapters/base.py — BaseAdapter ABC with abstract properties: section_patterns (dict of compiled regex), table_columns (dict of expected column names), schema_map (dict mapping OCPP action name → mobilityhouse JSON schema filename); (2) src/adapters/ocpp.py — OCPPAdapter for OCPP 2.0.1 Part 6: regex for TC_*/RS_* section headers, column name normalization, schema_map for all 2.0.1 actions pointing to ocpp/v201/schemas/*.json; (3) src/adapters/registry.py — get_adapter() factory.

context_needed.reason: Adapter interface contract and OCPPAdapter patterns

output.summary: Implemented BaseAdapter ABC, OCPPAdapter (35 schema mappings, TC_*/RS_* patterns, field normalisation), get_adapter() registry

steps.task: Implement the PDF extraction layer using pymupdf4llm as primary extractor: (1) src/extractors/base.py — BaseExtractor ABC with extract(pdf_path, adapter) → list[SectionChunk]; SectionChunk TypedDict has {id, title, markdown, page_start, page_end, section_type}; (2) src/extractors/pipeline.py — PdfExtractionPipeline: call pymupdf4llm.to_markdown(pdf_path) → split on H2/H3 headers using adapter.section_patterns → yield one SectionChunk per test case; pdfplumber fallback for pages where pymupdf4llm returns empty tables; (3) src/extractors/ocpp.py — OCPP-specific TOC offset detection and TC_ID extraction from chunk title; (4) tests/fixtures/sample_chunks.json — 2 synthetic SectionChunk dicts for unit tests (no real PDF needed).

context_needed.reason: SectionChunk output schema and extraction patterns

output.summary: Implemented SectionChunk TypedDict, PdfExtractionPipeline (pymupdf4llm primary, page-offset tracking, header splitting), OCPP TOC offset detection, sample_chunks.json fixture

steps.task: Implement the IR + LLM extraction layer. IMPORTANT: DataType definitions are imported from mobilityhouse/ocpp (ocpp.v201.datatypes, ocpp.v201.enums) — do NOT model datatypes from the PDF. Only TestCase and ReusableState require LLM extraction. Implement: (1) src/models/testcase.py — TestCase, Step, Assertion, Precondition Pydantic v2 models; (2) src/models/state.py — ReusableState model; (3) src/models/spec.py — SpecDocument with ir_version; (4) src/llm/schema_retriever.py — SchemaRetriever that loads mobilityhouse JSON schemas by action name (e.g., 'BootNotification' → ocpp/v201/schemas/BootNotificationRequest.json), returns schema dict for RAG injection; (5) src/llm/extractor.py — LLMExtractor with two-step extraction: Step 1 prompt classifies test type (sequence/field-validation/state-transition/timeout/error), Step 2 prompt extracts TestCase Pydantic model with the mobilityhouse schema injected as context; retry 3x on Pydantic ValidationError; uses Anthropic Messages API with response_format structured output; (6) src/ir/mapper.py — Orchestrates: for each SectionChunk → SchemaRetriever.get() → LLMExtractor.extract() → SpecDocument assembly.

context_needed.reason: IR schema design, two-step LLM extraction pattern, mobilityhouse integration
Example SectionChunk input for the mapper

output.summary: Implemented TestCase/Step/Assertion/Precondition/ReusableState/SpecDocument Pydantic v2 models, SchemaRetriever (mobilityhouse lru_cache), LLMExtractor (two-step: classify + tool_use extract, 3x retry on ValidationError), RawToIRMapper (LLM for test cases, rule-based for reusable states)

steps.task: Implement the code generation + QA layer: (1) src/generators/templates/test_module.py.j2 — Jinja2 template importing from ocpp.v201.enums and ocpp.v201.datatypes (mobilityhouse), generating @pytest.mark.asyncio async test functions; (2) src/generators/templates/conftest.py.j2 — template for pytest fixtures from ReusableStates; (3) src/generators/pytest_gen.py — PytestGenerator iterates SpecDocument.test_cases, renders templates, writes .py files; assertions use mobilityhouse enum members (e.g., RegistrationStatusType.accepted), NOT hard-coded strings; (4) src/generators/fixture_gen.py — FixtureGenerator for conftest.py; (5) src/generators/qa.py — SemanticQA class: for each generated test, embed its docstring + the source SectionChunk.markdown using sentence-transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), compute cosine similarity, write qa_report.json flagging tests with score < 0.7. All generated files start with AUTO-GENERATED header.

context_needed.reason: Template patterns and semantic QA approach

output.summary: Implemented Jinja2 templates (test_module.py.j2, conftest.py.j2), PytestGenerator (grouped by TC category), FixtureGenerator, SemanticQA (sentence-transformers cosine similarity, qa_report.json)

steps.task: Implement the CLI entry point: src/cli.py using Click — command `spec-to-test` with: pdf_path (required), --adapter (default: ocpp), --out (default: ./tests/generated/), --llm-model (default: claude-sonnet-4-6), --dry-run (extract + model only, skip code gen), --verbose. Wire together: get_adapter() → PdfExtractionPipeline.extract() → RawToIRMapper.map() → PytestGenerator.generate() → SemanticQA.run() → print qa_report summary. Register as console_scripts in pyproject.toml. Update README.md with usage example including --dry-run.

context_needed.reason: Planned CLI usage pattern to match

output.summary: Implemented Click CLI with --adapter, --out, --llm-model, --dry-run, --verbose, --cache-ir flags. Full pipeline wired: extract → map → generate → QA.

steps.task: Write unit tests for the extraction layer: tests/test_extractor.py — (1) test PdfExtractionPipeline.split_markdown_sections() with synthetic Markdown strings containing H2/H3 headers, assert correct SectionChunk count and titles; (2) test pdfplumber fallback path by mocking pymupdf4llm to return empty string; (3) test TC_ID extraction from OCPP-style headers ('TC_B01 Boot Notification'); (4) load tests/fixtures/sample_chunks.json and assert schema matches SectionChunk TypedDict. All tests must pass with `pytest tests/test_extractor.py`.

Write unit tests for the IR + LLM extraction layer: tests/test_ir.py — (1) test SchemaRetriever.get('BootNotification') returns a non-empty dict with 'properties' key; (2) test LLMExtractor with a mocked Anthropic client (mock the Messages API response to return a valid TestCase JSON), assert Pydantic model parses correctly; (3) test retry logic — mock returns invalid JSON on first 2 calls, valid on 3rd; (4) test RawToIRMapper.map() with sample_chunks.json fixture and mocked LLMExtractor, assert SpecDocument has correct test_cases count. All tests must pass with `pytest tests/test_ir.py`.

Write unit tests for the code generation + QA layer: tests/test_codegen.py — (1) construct a minimal SpecDocument with 2 TestCases and 1 ReusableState, run PytestGenerator.generate() into tmp_path, assert files exist and contain 'def test_' and '@pytest.fixture' and the AUTO-GENERATED header; (2) test assertion templates use mobilityhouse enum references (assert 'RegistrationStatusType' appears in output for a BootNotification test case); (3) test SemanticQA.run() with a high-similarity pair (score > 0.7) and a low-similarity pair (score < 0.7), assert qa_report.json flags only the low-similarity test. All tests must pass with `pytest tests/test_codegen.py`.
